justiceSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Word reaches you, days late: Sofia stands accused over what happened to Lena. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
Lena has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Sofia answers for what happened to Lena.
Lena calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken — you can hear the wind past the edge of the light.
Kofi counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "1 for guilty. 5 against."
A long exhale moves around the fire like weather. "Not guilty — this time."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Buy it off — It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase.

Lena spends the afternoon with the tree with orange fruit, soft when ripe — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Edible, but it argues on the way down. The fire's verdict: food, carefully. Small amounts.
📖 Codex: Confrontation — charges in a straight line, trampling everything in its path. You won't forget this.
💥 Confrontation!
Stag's Confrontation hits you for 7.
💥 Confrontation!
Stag's Confrontation hits you for 7.
💥 Confrontation!
Stag's Confrontation hits you for 10.
💥 Confrontation!
Stag's Confrontation hits you for 7.
💥 Confrontation!
Stag's Confrontation hits you for 9.

Travel 3 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail is worn smooth as an old coin. Deer, probably. Probably.
⚖️ The ruling seats: the Scroll swells on precedent (+40 HP); its jurisdiction settles over your body (−10 max HP, this fight).
🔍 Zhasulan crouches over tiny three-cornered nuts in spiny husks, under trees with smooth gray bark, studying it a moment before moving on. (2/3 looks)
🔍 Zhasulan has been turning over tiny three-cornered nuts in spiny husks, under trees with smooth gray bark for days — today it clicked. "I know this one now. Look — see the leaves?"
Vanessa showed Viviana the tiny three-cornered nuts in spiny husks, under trees with smooth gray bark — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
★ IDENTIFIED: Beechnut. Small three-sided nuts in spiny little cases under the smooth gray-barked trees. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
